worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.summary: Spread a light-bending film in front of you: status moves and seeds aimed at you during the window are bounced straight back at the user; an empty window just collapses.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.use.0: Send poison, paralysis and seeds aimed at you straight back
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.use.1: Have the film up before a foe applies a status
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.use.2: Make status-only foes suffer their own tricks
After %1$s of wind-up the film rises and holds for up to %2$s; a status move aimed at you in that time (afflictions, Leech Seed and the like) is turned back and immediately used by you against its original user. The film drops after it bounces one move.
Only such a move aimed at you from within %1$s blocks is caught; from farther away, or when the foe aims elsewhere, the film does nothing.
After a successful bounce the move goes on a %1$s cooldown; an empty film simply collapses and costs no PP. The bounced move is settled with your own stats.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.sweep.on: Wide film: reflect reach x1.3 to catch farther moves; the film is thinner (duration x0.8), +2 ticks wind-up, x1.1 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.sweep.off: Narrow film: duration x1.2, -1 tick wind-up, x0.9 cooldown to wait longer and cheaper; reflect reach x0.8.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.timing: Self move with a %1$s-block film reach; after %2$s of preparation the film rises. Only bouncing a move spends %4$s PP and starts the %5$s cooldown, then the recovery is %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.growth.0: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the film lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.growth.1: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the film lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.preference.s: Wide: reflect reach x1.3, but duration x0.8, +2 ticks wind-up, x1.1 cooldown. Narrow: duration x1.2, -1 tick wind-up, x0.9 cooldown, but reach x0.8. Reach or patience, pick one.
worldcombat.skill.magiccoat.preference.a: The partner only raises the film while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger prepares further out.
Anytime: raise at any threat, betting on a status move next. When pressured: raise only while the foe attacks the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the film.
